content: The filament sensor holders are poorly designed. If you want to remove the plug you either have to disasemble the whole thing or need some hook or something since the latches to release the kables face the wall of the filament holder. So please Prusa add a hole that makes the latches accessible from the other side. Then again I will replace them anyway since I am not mounting them on the side as intended.
This is a good time, if you are doing the gen2 to add the zip ties from 5-14 before you add back the side panels
Screw holes in FS-top were pretty tight. Recommend prethreading them with the same screws before attempting to screw on the other part.
